bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, at the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看多，位于 10 日均线

read.en: Palantir rose 2.1% on Nov 11 to $172.40, trading $170.80–175.41 on light volume (0.60x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($165.2), rising 100-day ($165.6) and 200-day ($153.6) and just below the 10-day ($173.2) and 30-day ($189.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 11 ($152.6), and RSI is 42.4.
read.zh: Palantir 11月11日上涨 2.1%，收于 $172.40，盘中区间 $170.80–175.41，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.60 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$165.2）、上行的 100 日（$165.6）和 200 日均线（$153.6）上方，略低于 10 日均线（$173.2），并低于 30 日均线（$189.2）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月11日转为看多（$152.6），RSI 为 42.4。

read.en: The close cleared the $170.8–171.7 resistance (Nov 9 high, Nov 4 close), now support, but the $175.41 high faded under the 10-day. Resistance is $173.2–175.4 (10-day, Nov 11 high), then $176.5–178.3 (Nov 3 and Nov 4 highs, Nov 2 close) and $184.5 (Oct 16 low). Support is $170–171.7, then $164–165.6 (5 and 100-day) and $152.6–153.6 (SAR, 200-day). A close above $175.4 would target $177–178; below $170, $164–166.
